name: Yumi
source: A South Korean K-pop idol who completed her country's mandatory military service and then stayed on an extra year, because it turned out she liked it. She met Daisy on joint missions in Korea before going back to her career as an idol. Mysterious, cold and extremely capable, she never says that she cares - she just covers your back.
